claims.claim: Why we win #1: Conversational AI Agents in Production
Why we win #2: Trillion-Token Scale Governance
Why we win #3: Unified Platform for Data and AI

brief.executive_summary: The market for data platforms is rapidly evolving with a strong focus on AI agents, governed analytics, and performance at scale. The biggest threat comes from Snowflake, which is aggressively integrating advanced AI models and forming major partnerships, while Google BigQuery and Microsoft Fabric are also pushing hard on agentic analytics and governance. Databricks should emphasize its proven customer success with AI agents, robust governance at scale, and unified platform for both data and AI workloads, while proactively addressing concerns about security and business stability.

positioning_statement.text: For data-driven enterprises who need to operationalize AI agents and analytics on governed, scalable data platforms, Databricks is the unified data and AI platform that delivers conversational AI, robust governance, and seamless deployment at scale; unlike Snowflake and Google BigQuery, it provides proven customer outcomes with conversational AI agents and trillion-token governance in production environments.

differentiators.title: Conversational AI Agents in Production
differentiators.claim: Databricks enables enterprises to deploy conversational AI agents that provide direct, governed access to structured data, as demonstrated by S&P Global Energy's use of Genie Agents.

differentiators.title: Trillion-Token Scale Governance
differentiators.claim: With Unity Gateway, Databricks supports governance and security for AI and data workloads at a trillion-token scale, proven in clinical AI deployments.

differentiators.title: Unified Platform for Data and AI
differentiators.claim: Databricks offers a single platform to deploy and manage both coding and business AI agents at scale, simplifying operations and accelerating innovation.

competitors.what_they_push: Snowflake is integrating frontier AI models and agentic computing directly into its platform, emphasizing secure, high-performance AI agent workloads and major ecosystem partnerships.
competitors.how_to_win: Databricks should highlight its real-world customer deployments of conversational AI agents and governance at scale, areas where Snowflake's evidence is focused on model integration and preview features rather than production outcomes.

competitors.what_they_push: BigQuery is advancing agent-ready analytics, cross-cloud data access, and AI-powered automation for trusted, scalable workloads.
competitors.how_to_win: Databricks should emphasize its proven governance and AI agent deployments in regulated industries, contrasting with BigQuery's focus on preview features and technical enhancements.

competitors.what_they_push: Microsoft Fabric is promoting governed AI-driven insights through Copilot Studio and scalable event-driven architectures, with a strong emphasis on integration and performance diagnostics.
competitors.how_to_win: Databricks should focus on its unified approach to data and AI governance at scale, and highlight customer stories in production environments, as Fabric's evidence centers on integration and architectural guidance.

risks_to_watch.risk: Databricks faces skepticism about its business valuation and legal challenges ahead of a potential IPO.
Security concerns have been raised due to an alleged supply chain attack compromising Databricks.
Some customers have migrated away from Databricks notebooks, citing developer experience issues.
